subject: Upcoming Payment Reminder for Your Utility Bills
body: Dear [Recipient], This is a friendly reminder that your utility bills for this month are due on the 15th. Please ensure payment is made on time to avoid any disruptions to your services. You can conveniently pay online through our website or visit our nearest branch. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. Sincerely, Utility Company
